recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; the seed request is already correctly represented in current core source, and adjacent fhirVersion issues are covered by separate combined-branch commits.
issue_request: FHIR-13548 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request to bind the fhirVersion element to a value set after a Zulip discussion about standardizing FHIR version strings.
initial_application: Git commit 0c7975f8f5534f90a1b2f67e0cf3d07859bc5399 applied the request in 2017 by adding FHIRVersions bindings to CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion and StructureDefinition.fhirVersion and adding FHIR version terminology source.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the intended targets were CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion and StructureDefinition.fhirVersion. Later related reconcile commits already on the combined branch address adjacent fhirVersion topics: FHIR-35168, FHIR-26065, FHIR-33050, FHIR-16317, and FHIR-18044. Confluence search found no FHIR-13548 references.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current active source files have required FHIRVersion bindings to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/FHIR-version on both relevant elements, and the FHIR-version CodeSystem declares the corresponding value set for all published FHIR versions.
